title: collapsible silicone steamer basket
text: collapsible silicone steamer basket. Where has this basket been all my life??  I have been longing for a steamer basket that wasn't metal and could stand up in a pan.  Now, these are meant to be used with your pressure cooker - but honestly, it works great in any pot it fits in!  PLUS you can dishwasher it.  PLUS it collapses so it takes up just a little bit of space in my pan drawer.  The handles are SO great to just lift and drain whatever you are steaming.  There are little feet on the bottom to keep the bulk of the steamer off the bottom of your pan.  The sides are tall, so fill it up!  It is NOT flimsy either.  It STAYS up even when empty.  Just the perfect little steamer.  It is EXACTLY what I've been looking for.  If you steam ANYTHING - veggies, dumplings, bread - YOU NEED this - and I rarely say that.  I've only just begun to use it, so time will tell. Having said that, I never hesitate to update my reviews should new info seem useful.  It is a little weird of a green - kinda mild alien (?ha?) but who cares about that?  Not me!  I'm into actual function.
